metadata.name: NunaWP4 Mackenzie River Delta Dissolved Organic Matter Fluorescence Dataset
metadata.description: This dataset contains dissolved organic matter (DOM) fluorescence measurements from the NunaWP4 Mackenzie expedition conducted in the Canadian Arctic (Mackenzie River Delta/Beaufort Sea coastal area) in 2019. It includes 146 water sample records with geographic coordinates, water depth, and multiple DOM fluorescence parameters: parallel factor analysis (PARAFAC) components (IFDOM C1-C3), excitation-emission matrix (EEM) peak components (FDOM A, C, M, T-peak), and derived indices (Fluorescence Index, Humification Index, Biological Index). The data characterizes terrestrial humic-dominated DOM sources in shallow Arctic waters.
metadata.spatial: Point measurements with GPS coordinates (Latitude, Longitude) stored in decimal degrees (WGS84); spatial precision approximately 111 m north-south (3 decimal places) and 3.5 m east-west (5 decimal places)
metadata.temporal: Irregular sampling intervals ranging from minutes to hours; timestamps recorded to second precision (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format) with minute-level effective granularity
